reminder.linePrev: And a fighter by his trade
reminder.lineNext: Of every glove that laid him down

stanza: Last call, he was sick of it all
Made him so sick of you, sick of you, sick of you
Sick of your sound, sick of you coming around

reminder.line: And the beard is a reminder
stanza: And the beard is a reminder
I'm a living part of him
Although my father's dead and gone
And still the dark stain spreads between
Of the poppy fields and graves
We spent what they had made
In the bottom of our hearts
